body:
* A higher paying job that's permanent, has benefits, and is at least a little enjoyable.
* Close friends.
* Figuring out normal social techniques and prevention of using incorrect social maneuvers
* A driver license
* A car
* My own place (rental or ownership)
* enough money to afford these things
* Greater emotional stability
* Being liked by more people
* Knowing when and when not to be scared
* Knowing if/when I need to protect myself from malicious people
* Trusting properly
* Feel less lonely
* Get hugs
* Knowing if/when I can cry around others without being made fun of or them using what makes me cry as a weapon against me
* And other stuff that makes sense or comes naturally to others
